paragraphs: Thousands of visitors are expected to attend Belgium’s annual autumn pumpkin festival at the historic Groot-Bijgaarden castle near Brussels.
Organizers anticipate around 50,000 people will visit the event, which celebrates the diverse and creative uses of squashes and pumpkins.

The displays feature thousands of vegetables sourced from across Belgium as well as distant countries like Portugal and Germany, with sizes ranging from small varieties to a massive 772-kilogram giant. Despite a challenging growing season caused by a hot summer, the festival offers far more than just a harvest exhibition. Attendees can participate in pumpkin carving workshops ahead of Halloween and even watch some of the largest pumpkins being used as makeshift kayaks.
The popular seasonal celebration successfully brings together families and gardening enthusiasts to enjoy autumn traditions and appreciate the remarkable versatility of this large vegetable.

paragraphs: A famous autumn pumpkin festival opened at a castle near Brussels. Around 50,000 visitors are expected to attend it.

The event celebrates pumpkins and squashes of all shapes and sizes, brought from Belgium, Portugal, and Germany. The biggest pumpkin at the festival weighs an impressive 772 kilograms. Even though the summer was very hot and made farming difficult, the harvest display is still wonderful. Visitors can enjoy many fun activities, such as carving pumpkins for Halloween or watching giant pumpkins used as boats on the water.
Families and autumn fans gather at the castle to celebrate the season, enjoy the festive atmosphere, and see creative pumpkin art.

paragraphs: A big pumpkin festival is happening at a castle near Brussels, Belgium. About 50,000 people will visit. They will see many pumpkins and squashes.

The pumpkins come from different countries and have many sizes. There is one huge pumpkin which weighs 772 kilos. Even though the summer is very hot this year, the festival is full of wonderful things.
People can carve pumpkins for Halloween, look at big vegetables, and even see pumpkins which look like small boats. Families love to go there to celebrate autumn and have a fun day out.
